source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Each time you pick this unit to fight, it may invoke its patrons. An unmodified 3+ on an attacking model’s **Wound roll** then scores a **Critical Wound** until the phase ends. If the unit invoked its patrons and none of its attacks destroyed an enemy model that phase, it loses one model as the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) closes.
